Fast mode (speed: "fast") gives the session lower latency and higher throughput; output quality is unchanged. It is available for lucy-2.5 / lucy-latest and lucy-vton-3.5 / lucy-vton-latest and is billed at 2x the standard realtime rate for those models. Other models ignore the option. Omit it (the default) for standard mode. See Fast mode.
